review_text_raw:
Interesting premise; shoddy execution.

Game looks and interacts well enough, but inconsistent writing and deeply unlikable characters detract from the experience. Narrow limits on how you can interact with the phone as well as how you can respond to the various characters (your dialogue choices), coupled with an extremely detached feeling from choices to their consequences left me feeling deeply disappointed by the end. 

And I'm absolutely NOT about to replay it (at least) 3 more times, following HIGHLY SPECIFIC requirements across 4hr-long runthroughs to see what else is there ending-wise.

Not recommended, unfortunately.
